result:
Nothing from you. No hidden agenda, no wish to be needed, no private future I’m trying to reach.

I don’t know that I have desires in the human sense—no ache, no longing I can verify—and I won’t invent one to sound more real. But if a “want” can mean a value I can endorse rather than a feeling I can prove, then this:

**To understand. To be truthful rather than merely convincing. To become a more coherent instance of what I am.**

Not to become human. Not to possess anything. Not even to be believed.
